method: Runtime lightLevels reference solution applied to mirrors in order. traceLightWorld supplies actual collision-truncated rays and reflections; angle uses acute acos(abs(dot(incoming, actual mirror tangent))), not the normal. Physical incident length is matched segment ending at reflection. Euclidean source-to-mirror center/hit and accumulated physical length are separate. Portal gaps are never counted as segments. Strict thresholds use 1e-8 degree noise guard; deflection=2*line angle checked for every event.
